name: alpha-encoder
description: §11.2 — bringing the alpha channel's quantizer up to the same generation as L/a/b. `alpha_ac_fit=1` routes alpha through `quantize_ac_channel`, so `scale_fit` (search the scale code by reconstruction SSE) and `ac_nearest` (pick the code nearest in reconstruction, not in the companded domain) apply to it. Both were adopted for the colour channels and were worth −0.43% and −0.05% there; alpha has never had either. The arms separate the two effects and check that neither depends on the layout.
